metadata.description: Marin Cervinschi's way of building software with Claude Code: a method plugin for every repo, and one plugin per named stack.

plugins.name: method
plugins.description: How a project is decided, tracked, written and reviewed: an interview for any plan, a spec interview, task tracking, plain writing, code comments, design principles, a feature review, safe changes and a pre-PR checklist. Fits any repo.

plugins.name: stack-web-ts
plugins.description: Full stack, v3: one TypeScript app with server-rendered React pages, server functions, Drizzle on Postgres and Better Auth in the same process. Overview, scaffold and pattern skills.

plugins.name: stack-rust-py-lab
plugins.description: Base stack: a dependency-free Rust core driven from Python through PyO3 and compiled to WebAssembly for the browser, for reproducible experiments.

plugins.name: stack-dotnet-next
plugins.description: Base stack: an ASP.NET Core API that publishes OpenAPI, a separate Next.js front on a generated client, long-running work in workers.

plugins.name: stack-dotnet-spa
plugins.description: Base stack: one ASP.NET Core process that serves the API and a Vite + React single-page app from the same origin.

plugins.name: stack-dotnet-blazor
plugins.description: Base stack: Blazor Server, where UI components run on the server over a live SignalR connection and call services in-process.
